privacyExport.source: The data comes from you (checkout, forms, emails). Payment providers report the payment status, the carrier reports the delivery status.
privacyExport.automated: I do not make automated decisions or create profiles. For payments, Stripe runs an automated fraud and risk check as an independent controller; Stripe provides information about it.
privacyExport.notesHint: Internal notes that may also concern other people are not included in the file. I reviewed them before sending; anything that concerns you is in my reply.

1.title: Request
1.text: Email or DM me: your idea or the flash number, placement, rough size.

2.title: Appointment

4.title: Tattooing

5.title: Aftercare

aftercare.intro: A fresh tattoo is a small wound. These steps help it heal in peace – and if you're unsure, just message me.
aftercare.emptyText: I'll give you the aftercare steps at your appointment. If you have questions, just message me.
aftercare.warnHeading: Warning signs – when to see a doctor?
aftercare.warnText: If the redness keeps spreading after three days, the area gets hot or very swollen, pus comes out, red streaks appear or you get a fever. Please let me know afterwards, too.

commission.lead: A cap with your dog on it, a plate with your own words, a picture for someone you like: tell me your idea – I'll paint it for you.

1.title: Request
1.text: Use the form to tell me what you'd like: object, motif, timeframe.
